items.heading: Rainwater harvesting
details: Captures rainfall for direct storage or to recharge groundwater for later use.

items.heading: Temple tanks
details: Store rainwater and can support groundwater recharge, depending on their design and local geology.

items.heading: Stepwells (Baoli / Vav)
details: Traditional multi-level structures for reliably accessing and storing water through dry seasons.

items.heading: Village tanks (Cheruvu / Kere / Eri)
details: Store seasonal rainwater for both agriculture and community use through the year.

items.heading: Traditional ponds
details: Provide local water storage and support the surrounding ecosystem.

items.heading: Earthen water pots
details: The porous clay provides evaporative cooling for stored drinking water.

items.heading: Covered household water storage
details: Keeping stored water covered reduces exposure to dust, insects, and other contaminants.

items.heading: Traditional protection of water sources
details: Community and cultural restrictions around water bodies can reduce pollution and overuse.
